plugins.name: zcode-beautify
plugins.description: Beautify the ZCode desktop client: import a background wallpaper, adapt UI colors with Material Design 3 (Monet) dynamic color, and tune everything from a live settings panel. Experimental CDP injection is explicit opt-in (disabled by default); /install-overlay adds a startup loader to app.asar so the look survives client updates and cleared plugin settings.
plugins.author: Mc-GrowlR
